meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('living, alive, live').

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!
You can't torture a living person like that!

examples.text: Нина, ну как ты могла? Живого человека ножом резать!
examples.trans: Nina, how could you? Cutting a living person with a knife!
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: Work, work. It's all for us.

meanings.note: слава богу = thank God (literally 'glory to God')

examples.text: О, наконец тепло! Слава богу. Сейчас ещё чай сделаю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's warm at last! Thank goodness. Now I'll make some tea too.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: He did not notice the loss.

examples.text: Никто на кухне ничего не заметил.
examples.trans: Nobody in the kitchen noticed anything.
And what if someone notices me?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'правляться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'deal with, finish off'.

examples.trans: So this is how you deal with the competition.

examples.text: Это слово «расправляться» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'deal with' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: in business, sport or an election

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'поднять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'lift slightly, raise'.

examples.trans: Here, let me help you up.

examples.text: Это слово «приподнять» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'lift slightly' is often heard in conversation.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Everyone thinks you're in the hospital.
He was admitted to the hospital.

examples.text: Все думают, ты в больнице. Откуда деньги?
examples.trans: Everyone thinks you're in the hospital. Where did the money come from?

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

examples.text: Она там взятки для врачей хранит.
examples.trans: She keeps bribes for the doctors in there.
All right, here you go. There, look.
